rows.grounds: Gloss 'in-sacrifice-and-others'; compound yajña+ādika with -ṣu loc.pl. ending (member+membership).
Gloss 'in-plants-then'; oṣadhī with sa- prefix context + -ṣu loc.pl.; 'atha' treated separately as indecl. in gloss 'in-plants-then' (AMBIGUOUS: sauṣadhīṣvatha split as sauṣadhīṣu + atha).
Gloss 'those'; demonstrative tāḥ = nom.pl.fem. of tad.
Gloss 'and-that'; tacca = tad + ca, nom.sg.n. of tad (ca indecl. compounded).
Gloss 'in-offspring-thus'; prajāsu with evam context, -su loc.pl.fem. of prajā; 'evaṃ' treated as indecl. per gloss 'in-offspring-thus' (member+membership).
Gloss 'universal-formhood'; compound viśva+rūpa+tā, nom.sg.f. abstract noun (member+membership).
